data.text: DEBUG MAP: EVERY ACTOR, ITEM AND PROP OF THE CATALOG
PORTAL: BACK TO THE START ISLAND
ACTORS: PENNED. A LANTERN HOLDS THE GHOST
PROPS: PUSH OR STEP ON THEM
PORTAL (I=10002, J=-9996) - BACK TO THE ARRIVAL POINT
STACKS: PUSH A CHEST, THEN STEP IN TO TAKE THE PILE
PUSH BOTH: COINS AND SEEDS IN ONE PILE
NESTING JARS: A JAR IN A JAR IN A JAR
PACKED BOX: TWO DOZEN THINGS INSIDE
DRAWER TOWER: PUSH IT AGAIN AND AGAIN
TOOTHPASTE ROCK: PUSH IT OVER THE WATER
YOUR STATUE: AN ECHO OPENS THE DOOR
CLOUD: PRESS IT AGAINST A WALL
PEBBLES: KICK THE ONE WITH EYES
BOOK: CATCH IT, SPELL ITS WORD
BOILED EGG: ROLL IT INTO A WALL
FLUFF: TOUCH IT, FILL THE PLOT
BLOCK FISH: FOUR IN A ROW
BAIT: X (OR THE BUTTONS) CHOOSES WHAT TO PUT. SPACE PUTS IT
PORTAL: TO THE BAIT ROOMS (THE TOOLS)
SUPPLIES. FISH MORE IN THE POND
APPLE: THE CHASER EATS IT, THEN SITS ON IT
FISH: THE CAT EATS IT, THEN SLEEPS ON IT
SEED: PLANT A STOPPER, ROLL THE BOULDER
MISSED? WALK AWAY AND BACK: THE BOULDER RETURNS
BOTH PLATES AT ONCE: WHO GETS WHICH, AND FIRST?
